critical_code_review_comments: Review request mentions data-testid 'viz-info-wellness-calculator-9', but code uses 'viz-info-<slug>' pattern (e.g., viz-info-bmi). Verified per-slug — likely a copy-paste typo in the review request (same as iteration 4). No code change needed.

Sparkline uses gradient IDs derived from the color hex (e.g., 'grad-CCFF00'). When multiple charts share the same color (e.g., pink for body-fat + navy-body-fat, yellow for W/Hip + W/Height, orange for waist + tdee) they will share the same SVG <linearGradient> id. Not visually broken in current rendering but violates unique-id best practice; consider making the id include the metric id to avoid future collisions/DOM cloning issues.
